select.onchange: (function(sel){var p=sel.closest('[data-question-type]'); if(!p){return;} p.querySelectorAll('input[type=radio]').forEach(function(r){var on=(r.value===sel.value); r.checked=on; if(on){r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}});})(this)
